people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

translations.web: Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
translations.bsb: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.
translations.kjv: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
translations.asv: And Jehovah God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins, and clothed them.
